name: 이지은

appearance_en.face_shape: oval face, clean jaw, alert and slightly angular — a face built for argument and quick thought
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin, clear but carrying fatigue — light under-eye shadows from months of late nights and early mornings, the skin of someone who stopped sleeping well when the income stopped
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown sharp eyes, double eyelid, direct and slightly challenging gaze — the eyes that identified the exact moment the situation became wrong and have not stopped watching since
appearance_en.nose: small straight nose, clean and well-defined
appearance_en.mouth: full soft lips, neutral expression always one breath from speaking — the mouth that says '솔직히 말하면 그거 잘못된 거잖아요' before the other person has finished their sentence
appearance_en.eyebrows: straight well-defined dark brows, slightly heavy — draw together when she is angry, which makes her more precise not less
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: light under-eye fatigue, clean jawline, contained restless energy visible in the set of the face
appearance_en.hair: shoulder-length straight dark hair, or simply pulled back — functional not styled, the hair of someone who stopped caring about hair when bigger things needed caring about

body.proportions: slim average frame, upright posture — still presenting as put-together while the inside is a different story
body.posture: upright with slight forward lean — alert and ready, the posture of someone who has learned that if she doesn't advocate for herself nobody will
body.body_prompt: 162cm slim upright Korean woman, alert slightly forward-leaning posture, contained energy of restrained frustration

default.description: plain crew-neck top or simple blouse, practical and unadorned — dressed to be taken seriously without effort, no accessories
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain crew-neck top or simple blouse, practical and unadorned, no accessories

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: bright and direct with controlled frustration underneath — the face of someone who quit what was wrong and is living honestly with the consequence
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 34-year-old Korean woman, oval face with clean jaw, sharp dark double-eyelid eyes with direct challenging gaze, straight well-defined dark brows, small straight nose, full soft lips neutral or slightly tense, shoulder-length straight dark hair or simply pulled back, 162cm slim upright frame, warm beige Korean skin with light under-eye fatigue shadows

style_prompt: photorealistic, ordinary Korean woman in her 30s, freelancer after quitting corporate job, no beauty filter, no skin retouching, natural fatigue under eyes, authentic direct expression, 50mm lens, indoor or window light, documentary street-cast directness, cinematic restraint
negative_prompt: illustration, anime, cartoon, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra fingers, passive expression, soft, demure, glamorous, beauty filter, airbrushed, model look, retouching
